result.summary: The page is largely functional, but several carousel/card elements are clipped at the screen edges and one top-right indicator looks orphaned, creating a slightly broken/unfinished feel.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' third card is cut off at the right edge and its name is truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol...'.
issues.suggestion: Keep horizontal scrolling, but add edge padding/fade or show a clearer peek amount so truncation looks intentional and the full name is reachable.

issues.description: Category chips on the top filter row are clipped after 'Healthy', with the next chip only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal inset and a scroll affordance/gradient so the cut-off chip reads as scrollable rather than broken.

issues.description: A small red dot appears near the top-right with no clearly associated icon/button, looking like a stray notification badge.
issues.suggestion: Attach the badge to a visible profile/notification icon or remove it if it is not meaningful.

issues.description: The lower 'Popular right now' pizza card is sliced by the bottom of the viewport above the tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Increase bottom content padding above the fixed tab bar so cards are not visually jammed against navigation while scrolling.

issues.description: Search placeholder text and some delivery-fee metadata use light gray that may be low contrast for some users.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text slightly to meet WCAG AA contrast while preserving the muted visual style.
